query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS equipment (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  equipment_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  manufacturer TEXT,
  model VARCHAR(255),
  serial_number VARCHAR(255),
  location TEXT,
  capacity JSON,
  operating_temperature_range JSON,
  operating_pressure_range JSON,
  mixing_speed_range JSON,
  power_rating JSON,
  compatible_material_types JSON,
  incompatible_materials JSON,
  material_contact_surfaces JSON,
  supported_processes JSON,
  cleaning_requirements TEXT,
  changeover_time DECIMAL(10, 2),
  status ENUM('operational', 'maintenance', 'offline', 'decommissioned') DEFAULT 'operational',
  last_maintenance_date TIMESTAMP NULL,
  next_maintenance_date TIMESTAMP NULL,
  maintenance_notes TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  INDEX idx_equipment_org (organization_id),
  INDEX idx_equipment_type (equipment_type)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS formulation_equipment_compatibility (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  formulation_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  equipment_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  is_compatible BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  compatibility_score DECIMAL(5, 2),
  incompatibility_reasons JSON,
  required_modifications JSON,
  processing_constraints JSON,
  analyzed_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  analyzed_by VARCHAR(36),
  notes TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (formulation_version_id) REFERENCES formulation_versions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (equipment_id) REFERENCES equipment(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  INDEX idx_formulation_equipment_org (organization_id),
  INDEX idx_formulation_equipment_formulation (formulation_version_id),
  INDEX idx_formulation_equipment_equipment (equipment_id)
);
